conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Cause and effect describes how one event or action (the cause) leads to another event or outcome (the effect). A common example is how rain (cause) makes the ground wet (effect).

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The strength of a cause-and-effect relationship often depends on the consistency and directness of the link between the cause and the effect. A strong relationship shows a clear and repeatable connection, while a weaker one might have multiple contributing factors or less direct links.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, if there are many other things that could also cause the effect, that makes the relationship weaker?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, exactly. When multiple factors could lead to the same effect, it weakens the singular cause-and-effect relationship.
